financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Cash from exercise of April 2025 warrants (575,188 shares) since June 30, 2025; exact receipt date not given, and the $1.1 million is the stated cash proceeds (net vs. gross not specified)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company has issued 575,188 shares of common stock for cash proceeds of $1.1 million upon exercise of certain April 2025 warrants since June 30, 2025.

warrants.quote: The new warrants (the “Common Warrants”) are exercisable for an aggregate of up to 1,260,752 shares of common stock. The Common Warrants have an exercise price of $1.90 per share
The placement agent warrants expire on April 24, 2030, and have an exercise price of $4.05 per share of common stock.
We also issued to the placement agent warrants to purchase up to 22,063 shares of common stock. These warrants have an exercise price equal to $4.3625 per share and are exercisable for five years.
